Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd stands as a prominent chemical enterprise specializing in the research, development, and production of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Strategically located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone in Binzhou, Shandong Province, China, the company has established itself as a key player in the cyclodextrin industry.

Founded with a commitment to innovation and quality, Huike Cyclodextrin Technology leverages advanced manufacturing technologies and state-of-the-art facilities to produce a comprehensive range of cyclodextrin products. These include alpha-cyclodextrin, beta-cyclodextrin, gamma-cyclodextrin, and various modified cyclodextrin derivatives that serve diverse industrial applications. The company's products are widely utilized in pharmaceuticals, food and beverages, cosmetics, agriculture, and environmental protection sectors.

The company benefits from its strategic location in Shandong Province, one of China's major chemical industry hubs, which provides excellent access to raw materials, skilled workforce, and efficient transportation networks. Huike Cyclodextrin Technology maintains strict quality control systems and has obtained relevant certifications to ensure product consistency and reliability. With a focus on sustainable development and technological advancement, the company continues to expand its production capacity and enhance its R&D capabilities to meet the growing global demand for high-quality cyclodextrin products while contributing to the advancement of green chemistry solutions.
